en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Idrees, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Al Mufazzal Bin Umar who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>.
(What about) the Words of the Majestic and Mighty [87:16] Nay! you are preferring the life of the world.
[87:17] While the hereafter is better and more lasting.
He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘Wilayah of Amir Al-Momineen<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>.
[87:18] Most surely this is in the earlier scriptures, [87:19] The scriptures of Ibrahim and Musa’.
en.sarwar: 30. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from ‘Abdallah ibn Idris from Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-Fudayl ibn ‘Umar who has said the following.
“I asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the meaning of the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious.

“However, (the unbelievers) prefer the worldly life, [87:16] -The Imam (a.s.) said, “They have preferred their (evil doers) friendship-” even though the life hereafter will be better and will last forever –The Imam (a.s.)said, “It means the friendship of Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) - [87:17].
This is what is written in the ancient heavenly Books,[87:18] the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses [87:19].”
